environmentVariables.description: Bearer API key issued by HoodGrow (DM https://x.com/hoodgrow). Optional if HOODGROW_PRIVATE_KEY is set instead.

environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" (only meaningful alongside HOODGROW_PRIVATE_KEY) to spend a prepaid credit balance instead of paying x402 per call — buy one first with the buy_credits tool.
